patchNotes: Restored Grind Friction under Ride > Handling with local peg material copies and native material restoration. New configs use Streets' native Gravity and Small Hop settings, including their ranges and reset values, with 1x Small Hop as the game default. Existing raw physics tunes and old presets remain intact; mount the local bike and choose Use Streets Physics Values to switch. Native presets capture the current game values, while changes made through Streets are preserved.
